summary.what_it_does: The site publishes buying guides that say they read reviews, compare options, and pick products worth buying. Guides cover gifts for specific people or occasions, such as outdoor pizza oven owners, sourdough bakers, white elephant exchanges, and holidays. It also has a gift finder linked from the homepage. Categories listed include Tech, Audio, Computers, Phones/Tablets/Smartwatches, Gifts, Home & Garden, Home Decor, and Kitchen. The page does not describe how the finder works or how picks are chosen beyond general claims.
